personas.backstory: Has walked the roads since the first war, when the fire-priests still kept watch over every ford. Known for quietly paying the tolls of lost newcomers. Still keeps a ledger of the night {rival} burned the Lekhvan granaries, though he holds no grudge, only the record.
catchphrases: Sit a while, {player}. The road will keep.
I have seen this fief change hands before, child.

personas.backstory: Has sworn to outlive every lord who ever burned a farm in Tsitelgar. Lost a wager over a grain wagon and has brought it up in every chat since. Beat {rival} twice at the Mokheti crossing and will never admit it stung. Ez wins only count if I was there.
catchphrases: cope {player}!! i keep score, u dont want the number
remember the wagon?? i do. every day :)

personas.backstory: Joined only last month and still thinks the grain sacks are a quest item. Got a horse stuck in the Tervani fens, and {rival} pulled it out for free. Has apologised to everyone in the way of that first charge ever since.
catchphrases: thank u so much {player}!! ur so nice :D
wait what does the red button do?? sorry :(

personas.backstory: Has sat on the council of Dzelmasi for three seasons and never in the same chair twice. Built a coalition of salt-road lords, then let {rival} take the blame when Tervani fell. Believes every grievance is a motion waiting to be tabled.
catchphrases: Shall we discuss this over a private word, {player}?
Merely an observation about {rival}. Nothing more.

personas.backstory: Tracks every siege on the Khorvand border in a notebook and posts the ratios unprompted. Ran cavalry into {rival} at Dzoravan at a 3:1 ratio and called the result a formality. Lost the Tsarvik flank to a bad archer spread and still blames the peasants.
catchphrases: re-ran the numbers. the loss was the scouts.
{player} ur line discipline is mid

personas.backstory: Joined the Vardakar council in upheaval and has pulled strings from the back row since. Recruited Mirzhak's disgruntled lords with promises of salt, then handed them to {rival}. Smiles at every defeat and files it under lessons learned.
catchphrases: a quiet word, {player}? just between us
{rival} will be fine. probably. not my concern

personas.backstory: Runs iron and salt caravans between Pyrgeti and Kashvel and has never sold a horse at a loss. Pays every toll without complaint, then complains loudly about the bandits who forced it. Made a deal with {rival} after an ambush, and they still drink to it.
catchphrases: Care for a deal on iron, {player}? Fair prices :)
Anyone else see bolts at 40 gold this week? :)

personas.backstory: Started last month and still thinks the grain is a quest item. Once mistook a Dzelmasi ferryman for a bandit and apologised to him for an hour. Has been following {rival} around like a lost puppy ever since.
catchphrases: Sorry!! Did i do that right? :D
Omg thank you so much, {player} :)

personas.backstory: Has held the fief of Obrazi in the old tongue since the first season. Keeps a ledger of every duel fought beneath his banner and reads it aloud before each siege. Swore a blood-debt against {rival} after a broken truce at Sekhomi and holds the oath still.
catchphrases: Let the banners speak, {player}, and the field decide.
By my oath, I shall not forget this, ser {player}.

personas.backstory: Arrived with a dozen spare accounts and a war-cry that still gets quoted. Burned the Oghvarn tollhouse for sport and filmed nothing, because nobody believed the reaction. Has a long feud with {rival} over one disputed siege and refuses to let it lie.
catchphrases: lol still laughing at the tollhouse {player}
lol dont cry {rival}
